name: pre-ship-performance-audit-mod
description: Reminds Claude to run the pre-ship performance audit before a production deploy.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: hold a ship command and ask whether to run the checks first. block: refuse until the checks have run. nudge: let it run and remind Claude afterwards. off: do nothing.

required.title: Required check skills
required.description: Comma-separated names of the skills that must have run before a ship command. All of them must have run.
